3:["$","p","2",{"className":"text-lg leading-relaxed text-gray-700","children":"Payment tokenization is another critical trend that is enhancing the security of contactless transactions. Tokenization replaces sensitive card data with unique, transaction-specific tokens that are useless if intercepted. This technology, already widely used in mobile wallets like Apple Pay and Google Pay, is now being extended to card-on-file transactions, recurring payments, and e-commerce checkout. For merchants, tokenization reduces the scope of PCI compliance and lowers the risk of data breaches, making it an increasingly attractive security investment."}]
4:["$","p","3",{"className":"text-lg leading-relaxed text-gray-700","children":"The convergence of payment and identification technologies is also creating new possibilities. Additionally, the integration of loyalty programs, coupons, and personalized offers directly into the payment flow is transforming the checkout experience from a purely transactional interaction into a relationship-building opportunity."}]
